leadText:
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection is a Region 4 DVD released by in Australia on November 7, 2018 . It contains a total of 118 discs with a total runtime of approximately 357 hours from the Slimpack releases of the first 20 seasons of . Its catalogue number is BHE8026.

The DVDs included in this set are encoded in the color-coding system, and are region-locked to . It utilises , and aspect ratios.
